snippet.title: So May It Be: A Witch Dating Simulator - Release Trailer
snippet.description:
✨So May It Be: A Witch Dating Simulator✨ releases on Valentines day 2020 (Friday 14th February). Play as a witch hanging out with your witchy friends. Will you ditch school, contact the dead or fall in love? 

A game summoned by Planchette Games
